1.syllabus: Grading: see the course page. Late-work policy: late work loses credit each day. Office hours: Tuesday afternoons. Week 1: Cell structure - nucleus, mitochondria, chloroplasts, endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi apparatus; microscopy basics. Week 2: Membrane structure and membrane transport (diffusion, osmosis, active transport). Oct 20: Lab safety quiz. Week 3: Enzymes and metabolism. Week 4: Cellular respiration. Week 5: Photosynthesis. Week 6: Cell cycle and mitosis. Week 7: Meiosis. Week 8: Mendelian genetics.

2.syllabus: Week 1: Cell structure (nucleus, ribosomes, plasma membrane). Week 2: Membrane transport. Oct 20: Lab safety quiz. Week 3-4: Respiration and photosynthesis. Week 5: DNA structure and replication. Office hours: Thursdays after class.

3.syllabus: Week 1: Cell structure and organelles; lab safety quiz. Week 2: Membrane transport. Week 3: Respiration. Late work not accepted.
